_meta.about: Nifty 500 tail (U to Z) plus unlisted startups: ed-tech, B2B commerce, agritech. Leaders checked on the web where possible; others marked not re-checked.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: UNO Minda

parts.SELLS: UNO Minda makes auto parts: lighting, switches, horns, alloy wheels, seating systems, sensors and a growing range of electric-vehicle parts such as motor controllers and chargers. Its buyers are two-wheeler, car and commercial-vehicle makers, plus the replacement market.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying parts under long relationships with vehicle makers, with a steady aftermarket business on top. Switches and lighting for two-wheelers and cars are its core, and it runs several joint ventures with Japanese and Chinese partners for technology.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest auto component groups and a leading supplier of switches and automotive lighting, with plants across India and some overseas. Its customer list includes most major Indian vehicle makers.
parts.RIVALS: Lumax Industries in lighting, Varroc Engineering, Bosch, Spark Minda (Minda Corporation, a separate group) and Sona Comstar in EV parts. Global suppliers such as Valeo also compete for lighting and electronics orders.
parts.WATCH: In 2025 Nirmal Minda became executive chairman and Ravi Mehra took over as managing director. Watch its new plants for EV components and alloy wheels, and how fast electric two-wheeler demand grows.

quiz.prompt: Who became UNO Minda's managing director in 2025?
Which of these is a core UNO Minda product line?
Which company is a rival to UNO Minda in automotive lighting?

companies.note_30w: UNO Minda supplies switches, lighting, alloy wheels and EV parts to Indian vehicle makers. Ravi Mehra now runs it day to day; watch its electric-vehicle components push.

companies.name: UTI Asset Management (UTI AMC)

parts.SELLS: UTI AMC runs UTI Mutual Fund, one of India's oldest fund houses, which grew out of the government's Unit Trust of India. It offers equity, debt, hybrid and index funds to households, and also manages pension money through UTI Retirement Solutions and funds for overseas clients.
parts.EARNS: It earns a management fee on the money in its schemes, charged as a small share of assets each year. Equity funds earn the richest fees; its pension and offshore businesses add steadier income. Its large shareholders include SBI, LIC, Bank of Baroda, PNB and T. Rowe Price.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger mutual fund houses and among the oldest, with a strong presence in smaller towns through a wide distributor network. Its pension and offshore arms widen its reach beyond mutual funds.
parts.RIVALS: SBI Mutual Fund, HDFC AMC, ICICI Prudential AMC, Nippon India Mutual Fund and Kotak Mutual Fund. In pension fund management it competes with SBI Pension Funds, HDFC Pension and LIC Pension Fund.
parts.WATCH: Vetri Subramaniam, its long-time chief of fund management, became MD & CEO in February 2026, succeeding Imtaiyazur Rahman. Watch SEBI's changes to fund expense rules and whether UTI regains share in equity funds.

quiz.prompt: Who became UTI AMC's MD & CEO in February 2026?
How does UTI AMC mainly earn money?
options: Management fees on the money in its schemes

quiz.prompt: Which of these is a rival fund house?

companies.note_30w: UTI AMC runs UTI Mutual Fund, a fund house born from the Unit Trust of India, earning fees on schemes and pensions. Vetri Subramaniam took charge in 2026.

companies.name: Usha Martin

parts.SELLS: Usha Martin makes steel wire ropes, wires and strands used in oil rigs, mines, cranes, elevators, bridges and fishing. It also makes related products like cables and conveyor cord. It sold its steel-making business to Tata Steel in 2019 to focus on wire ropes.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling specialised ropes, often engineered to order for oil and gas, mining and infrastructure customers. A large part of revenue comes from exports, helped by its plants and distribution units in the UK, the UAE and Thailand alongside its Indian plants in Ranchi and Hoshiarpur.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's leading makers of steel wire ropes and among the largest in India, with a global sales and service network. Its ropes are used on oil platforms, in mines and on cranes in many countries.
parts.RIVALS: Bharat Wire Ropes in India, and global players such as Bridon-Bekaert and WireCo WorldGroup. It also competes with Chinese and Korean rope makers in export markets, especially on price.
parts.WATCH: Watch its push into high-value ropes for offshore oil, mining and elevators, demand from infrastructure projects, and how trade tariffs affect its export markets.

quiz.prompt: What is Usha Martin's main product?
Which business did Usha Martin sell to Tata Steel in 2019?
Which Indian company is a rival in wire ropes?

companies.note_30w: Usha Martin makes specialised steel wire ropes for oil rigs, mines, cranes and elevators, with a large export business. It exited steel-making in 2019 to focus on ropes.

companies.name: Vardhman Textiles

parts.SELLS: Vardhman Textiles makes cotton and blended yarn, woven fabrics, acrylic fibre and some garments. Its buyers are fabric mills, garment exporters and global apparel brands. It is the flagship of the Ludhiana-based Vardhman group.
parts.EARNS: Yarn is its largest business, sold to weavers and knitters in India and abroad; fabric is the second pillar. Profits swing with cotton prices and the gap between cotton and yarn prices, so buying cotton well matters a lot.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest textile companies and among its biggest yarn spinners, with mills spread across Punjab, Himachal Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. Its scale in yarn gives it strong buying power in cotton.
parts.RIVALS: Trident, Arvind, KPR Mill, Nitin Spinners and Welspun Living in parts of the value chain. Exporters from Bangladesh, Vietnam and China also compete for global garment orders.
parts.WATCH: Watch cotton prices, US tariffs on Indian textile exports, and the India-UK trade deal, which opens up a market for Indian fabrics and garments. Also watch government support for textiles under the PM MITRA parks scheme.

quiz.prompt: What is Vardhman Textiles' largest business?
In which city is Vardhman Textiles based?
Which company is a textile rival of Vardhman?

companies.note_30w: Vardhman Textiles is a major Indian yarn and fabric maker from Ludhiana. Profits ride on cotton prices; watch US tariffs and the India-UK trade deal.

companies.name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal

parts.SELLS: Vedanta Aluminium makes primary aluminium, in ingots, billets, wire rods and rolled products, sold to power, auto, packaging and construction customers in India and abroad. It was carved out of Vedanta Ltd and listed separately in June 2026 as part of the group's demerger.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling aluminium at prices linked to the London Metal Exchange, so global prices drive profits. Its edge is low cost: it makes its own alumina at Lanjigarh in Odisha and runs captive power for its smelters at Jharsuguda in Odisha and BALCO in Chhattisgarh.
parts.SIZE: India's largest aluminium producer and one of the biggest outside China. It runs some of the largest aluminium smelters in the world, in Odisha and Chhattisgarh, backed by its own alumina refinery.
parts.RIVALS: Hindalco Industries and state-owned NALCO in India, and global producers such as Rio Tinto, Alcoa and Chinese smelters. Imports also compete in India.
parts.WATCH: Vedanta has announced plans to roughly double smelting capacity and expand the Lanjigarh refinery. Watch bauxite and coal mine supply, the new company's debt after the demerger, and global aluminium prices.

quiz.prompt: When was Vedanta Aluminium listed as a separate company?
What mainly drives Vedanta Aluminium's profits?
options: Global aluminium prices and its production cost

quiz.prompt: Which state-owned company competes with Vedanta Aluminium?

companies.note_30w: Vedanta Aluminium, demerged and listed in 2026, is India's largest aluminium maker, with its own alumina refinery and power. Watch its smelter expansion and global aluminium prices.

companies.name: Vedanta Iron and Steel

parts.SELLS: Vedanta Iron and Steel holds the group's iron ore mines in Goa and Karnataka, the ESL Steel plant in Bokaro, Jharkhand, and pig iron and metallurgical coke units. It was separated from Vedanta Ltd and listed on its own in June 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling iron ore, pig iron and steel products such as long steel and ductile iron pipes. Steel from ESL is the largest piece, while ore from its own mines lowers its raw material costs.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized steel and iron ore player with large iron ore resources, much smaller than India's top steelmakers. Its iron ore mines in Goa were once among India's biggest ore exporters.
parts.RIVALS: JSW Steel, Tata Steel, Jindal Steel, SAIL and NMDC in iron ore. Its iron ore business also competes with private miners in Odisha and Karnataka. Imports too.
parts.WATCH: The group has announced plans to expand ESL Steel and move into electrical, specialty and green steel. Watch mining restarts in Goa, steel prices and cheap imports.

quiz.prompt: Where is Vedanta's ESL Steel plant?
Which is a larger rival steelmaker?
What new steel areas has the group said it will focus on?

companies.note_30w: Vedanta Iron and Steel, demerged in 2026, combines Goa and Karnataka iron ore mines with ESL Steel in Bokaro. Watch its expansion plans and steel prices.

companies.name: Vedanta Oil and Gas (Cairn)

parts.SELLS: Vedanta Oil and Gas, known as Cairn Oil and Gas, produces crude oil and natural gas, mainly from the Rajasthan block in Barmer, with smaller offshore fields at Ravva and in Cambay. It was demerged from Vedanta Ltd and listed separately in June 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling crude and gas at prices linked to global benchmarks, after sharing profit with the government under production-sharing contracts. Rajasthan's Mangala, Bhagyam and Aishwariya fields bring in most of its income.
parts.SIZE: India's largest private-sector producer of crude oil, behind only state-owned ONGC overall among domestic producers. Its Rajasthan fields are among the largest onshore oil discoveries in India.
parts.RIVALS: ONGC and Oil India in exploration and production, and Reliance Industries in gas. Global oil producers set the prices it gets, so it also competes indirectly with imported crude.
parts.WATCH: Watch the extension of its Rajasthan contract with the government, new exploration blocks it won in government licensing rounds, its stated ambition to raise output sharply, and global oil prices.

quiz.prompt: Where is Cairn's main oil block?
How are Cairn's oil prices set?
options: Set by OPEC for India only

quiz.prompt: Which state-owned company is Cairn's biggest rival?

companies.note_30w: Vedanta Oil and Gas, or Cairn, is India's largest private crude producer, centred on Rajasthan's Barmer fields. Watch contract extensions, new blocks and global oil prices.

companies.name: Vedanta Power

parts.SELLS: Vedanta Power runs coal-fired power plants, including Talwandi Sabo in Punjab, and sells electricity to state utilities and on power exchanges. It was demerged from Vedanta Ltd and listed separately in June 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns from long-term power purchase agreements with state electricity boards, which give steady income, plus sales on power exchanges when prices are high. Talwandi Sabo, which supplies Punjab, is its anchor plant.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger private thermal power producers, though well behind NTPC and Adani Power. Talwandi Sabo in Punjab is among the larger private thermal plants in North India.
parts.RIVALS: NTPC, Adani Power, Tata Power, JSW Energy and Torrent Power. Renewable producers such as Adani Green and ReNew also compete for state utility contracts.
parts.WATCH: Vedanta has announced plans to add generating capacity and to explore hydro and nuclear power. Watch coal supply, new power purchase agreements and rising peak electricity demand.

quiz.prompt: Which plant is Vedanta Power's anchor asset?
Who buys most of Vedanta Power's electricity?
Which company is a rival thermal power producer?

companies.note_30w: Vedanta Power, demerged in 2026, runs coal power plants like Talwandi Sabo and sells mainly to state utilities. Watch its capacity additions and hydro, nuclear ambitions.

companies.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre

parts.SELLS: Vijaya Diagnostic runs diagnostic centres that offer both pathology tests, like blood work, and radiology, like MRI and CT scans, under one roof. Most of its patients walk in directly. It is strongest in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and has expanded into Kolkata, Pune and Bengaluru.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees per test, mostly from walk-in patients rather than hospital referrals or labs. Combining radiology with pathology lifts revenue per visit, and its home market of Hyderabad drives most of its income.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading diagnostic chains and the largest in South India's Telugu states by most accounts. It has built a strong brand among patients in Hyderabad over decades.
parts.RIVALS: Dr Lal PathLabs, Metropolis Healthcare, Thyrocare, Apollo Diagnostics and Tata 1mg Labs. Hospital-run labs and local standalone diagnostic centres also compete in every city.
parts.WATCH: Watch its new hub centres outside the Telugu states, how quickly new centres break even, and price competition from online lab-test platforms. Also watch leadership changes in its finance and technology teams.

quiz.prompt: What makes Vijaya Diagnostic different from many lab chains?
options: It offers radiology and pathology under one roof

quiz.prompt: Where is Vijaya Diagnostic strongest?
Which is a rival diagnostic chain?

companies.note_30w: Vijaya Diagnostic runs combined pathology and radiology centres, led by Hyderabad and the Telugu states. Watch its expansion into new cities and competition from online labs.

companies.name: Vishal Mega Mart

parts.SELLS: Vishal Mega Mart runs value hypermarkets selling clothes, home goods and groceries to middle and lower-middle income families, mostly in smaller cities. Much of what it sells is its own brands. It listed on the stock exchanges in December 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns a retail margin on goods sold. Clothing and general merchandise, mostly own brands, make up the bigger and more profitable part of sales, while groceries drive footfall. It runs on leased stores to keep costs light.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest value retailers, with a wide network of stores across tier-two and tier-three towns. Its stores are concentrated in smaller towns where organised retail is still young.
parts.RIVALS: DMart, Reliance Retail's Smart Bazaar and Trends, Tata's Zudio, V-Mart and Style Bazaar. Online platforms such as Meesho and Flipkart also compete for its value-seeking shoppers.
parts.WATCH: Watch new store openings in the north and east, growth of its app-based home delivery, and stake sales by its private-equity-backed promoter. Its board reappointed Gunender Kapur as MD and CEO for a fresh term from September 2026.

quiz.prompt: Who is Vishal Mega Mart's core customer?
Which category is more profitable for Vishal?
Which of these is a value-retail rival?

companies.note_30w: Vishal Mega Mart sells mostly own-brand clothes, home goods and groceries to value-seeking families in smaller cities. Listed in 2024; watch its store expansion.

companies.name: Welspun Corp

parts.SELLS: Welspun Corp makes large-diameter steel pipes for oil, gas and water pipelines, plus ductile iron pipes, TMT bars and specialty steel. It also owns Sintex, the water-tank and plastics brand it bought in 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns from big pipeline orders won from oil companies and water projects in India and the US. Line pipes are its largest business, with its US plant in Little Rock, Arkansas a key earner from American gas pipelines.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest makers of large-diameter welded line pipes, with plants in India, the US and Saudi Arabia. Its pipes have been used in major oil, gas and water pipelines across several continents.
parts.RIVALS: Jindal SAW, Ratnamani Metals, Man Industries and Maharashtra Seamless in pipes; Supreme Industries in Sintex's categories. Global pipe makers also bid for overseas projects.
parts.WATCH: Watch US pipeline demand and trade tariffs, its expansion in the US and Saudi Arabia, and India's water-pipeline projects under the Jal Jeevan Mission.

quiz.prompt: What is Welspun Corp's largest business?
options: Line pipes for oil, gas and water

quiz.prompt: Which consumer brand did Welspun Corp buy in 2023?
Which company is a pipe rival?

companies.note_30w: Welspun Corp makes large steel line pipes for oil, gas and water in India and the US, plus Sintex tanks. Watch US pipeline demand and tariffs.

companies.name: Welspun Living

parts.SELLS: Welspun Living, formerly Welspun India, makes towels, bed sheets, rugs and other home textiles, plus flooring. It supplies big US and UK retailers like Walmart and Target, and also sells its own brands Welspun, Spaces and Christy. It was renamed in 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns mainly by exporting home textiles to large retailers under long relationships. The US is by far its biggest market and towels and bed linen its largest products; flooring and domestic brands are smaller but growing.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest home-textile makers and among the biggest suppliers of towels to US retailers. It also has a growing presence in Indian homes through its own retail brands.
parts.RIVALS: Trident, Indo Count Industries and Himatsingka Seide in India, plus Pakistani and Chinese exporters. Its own Indian brands compete with D'Decor, Bombay Dyeing and online home brands.
parts.WATCH: Watch US tariffs on Indian goods, the India-UK trade deal that helps its UK business, and growth in its flooring and Indian retail brands. Also watch its push into advanced textiles and the growth of its Spaces brand.

quiz.prompt: What was Welspun Living's earlier name?
Which is Welspun Living's biggest market?
Which Indian company competes in towels and bed linen?

companies.note_30w: Welspun Living, formerly Welspun India, exports towels, bed linen and rugs mainly to US retailers like Walmart. Watch US tariffs and its UK and flooring growth.

companies.name: Whirlpool of India

parts.SELLS: Whirlpool of India makes refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners and microwaves, and also sells water purifiers and kitchen appliances. It is the Indian listed arm of US-based Whirlpool Corporation and also owns a stake in kitchen-appliance maker Elica India.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling appliances through dealers, large retail chains and online. Refrigerators are its biggest and strongest category, followed by washing machines, while air conditioners are smaller.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading appliance brands and among the top players in refrigerators and washing machines. It sells through a wide dealer network that reaches small towns across India.
parts.RIVALS: LG, Samsung, Godrej, Haier and Voltas Beko. Other rivals include Bosch and IFB in washing machines, and Blue Star in air conditioners. Online-first brands add pressure.
parts.WATCH: Its US parent cut its stake in 2025 and has said it plans to reduce it further. Watch the effect on ownership and brand licensing, and how Whirlpool defends share against fast-growing Haier and Voltas Beko.

quiz.prompt: What is Whirlpool of India's biggest product category?
Who is Whirlpool of India's parent?
What did its parent announce about its stake?
options: It will raise it to full ownership
It will merge it with Elica
It plans to reduce it further

companies.note_30w: Whirlpool of India sells refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners, with refrigerators the strongest. Its US parent is reducing its stake; watch rivals LG and Haier.

companies.name: Wockhardt

parts.SELLS: Wockhardt makes generic medicines, vaccines and biologics, and is known for its own research into new antibiotics for drug-resistant infections. India approved its antibiotic Miqnaf (nafithromycin) in 2025, and it has filed its antibiotic Zaynich with the US FDA.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling branded generics in India and generics in Europe, where its UK business is one of its biggest. The hope is that patented antibiotics like Zaynich will add higher-margin income from global markets.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian drugmaker, but among the few Indian companies to discover and develop new antibiotics. Its UK operations give it a meaningful presence in the British medicines market.
parts.RIVALS: Sun Pharma, Cipla, Lupin and Glenmark in generics; global antibiotic developers such as Pfizer and GSK. Antibiotic research in India is rare, so its closest research rivals are global firms.
parts.WATCH: Watch the US FDA decision on Zaynich, the launch of Miqnaf in India, and how it funds research while cutting its debt. Also watch demand from hospitals for new antibiotics against resistant infections.

quiz.prompt: What is Wockhardt known for in research?
Which Wockhardt antibiotic is filed with the US FDA?
Which company is a generics rival to Wockhardt?

companies.note_30w: Wockhardt sells generics in India and Europe and develops new antibiotics like Miqnaf and Zaynich. Watch the US FDA decision on Zaynich and its debt reduction.

companies.name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India

parts.SELLS: ZF CV India, formerly WABCO India, makes braking and control systems for trucks, buses and trailers: air brakes, anti-lock braking systems, air compressors, valves and electronic controls. It was renamed after Germany's ZF bought WABCO globally in 2020.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying truck and bus makers such as Tata Motors and Ashok Leyland, by exporting parts to ZF companies abroad, and from the replacement aftermarket. Exports and aftermarket help balance the ups and downs of truck sales.
parts.SIZE: India's leading maker of air-braking systems for commercial vehicles. Most big Indian truck and bus makers use its braking systems, and it also exports to ZF plants worldwide.
parts.RIVALS: Brakes India (TVS group), Knorr-Bremse and Haldex. Global brake makers also compete with it for export and aftermarket business. Its parent's scale is its edge.
parts.WATCH: Watch truck and bus demand, safety rules that push advanced braking and stability systems, and growth in exports to its parent's global plants. Paramjit Singh Chadha took over as managing director in July 2025.

quiz.prompt: What was ZF CV India's earlier name?
Which customers does ZF CV India mainly supply?
Which company is a rival in braking systems?

companies.note_30w: ZF CV India, formerly WABCO India, makes air brakes and control systems for trucks and buses, and exports to its German parent. Watch truck demand and safety rules.

companies.name: Zee Entertainment

parts.SELLS: Zee runs TV channels in Hindi and many regional languages, such as Zee TV, Zee Cinema, Zee Marathi and Zee Tamil, plus the ZEE5 streaming app, Zee Studios films and Zee Music. Its planned merger with Sony's Indian business was called off in 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns from advertising on its channels and apps and from subscription fees paid by cable, DTH and streaming viewers. Linear TV is still the main earner, while ZEE5 has been narrowing its losses.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest TV broadcasters, with a big library of shows and films and strong regional channels. Its regional channels are among the most watched in several Indian languages.
parts.RIVALS: JioStar (the Reliance-Disney merger), Sony Pictures Networks India, Sun TV, and streaming apps like Netflix and Amazon Prime Video. YouTube also competes for viewers.
parts.WATCH: Watch how Zee competes with the much larger JioStar, ZEE5's path to profit, falling TV advertising, and the promoter family's plan to raise its stake.

quiz.prompt: What is Zee's streaming app called?
What happened to Zee's planned merger with Sony's India business?
Which is Zee's largest broadcasting rival?

companies.note_30w: Zee runs Hindi and regional TV channels plus ZEE5, earning from ads and subscriptions. The Sony merger collapsed in 2024; watch competition from JioStar.

companies.name: Zen Technologies

parts.SELLS: Zen Technologies makes combat training simulators, such as tank, gunnery and driving simulators and live firing ranges, and anti-drone systems. Its main buyers are the Indian Army, other armed forces, paramilitary and police, plus some overseas militaries.
parts.EARNS: It earns from defence contracts for simulators and anti-drone systems, and from annual maintenance contracts that bring repeat income. Orders are lumpy, so revenue can swing a lot between years.
parts.SIZE: India's leading maker of military training simulators and one of the key domestic anti-drone players. Its simulators are used by the Indian Army and by several foreign forces.
parts.RIVALS: Bharat Electronics, Tata Advanced Systems and global simulator makers such as CAE. Foreign simulator makers also bid for Indian contracts, though local buying rules favour Indian firms.
parts.WATCH: Watch new defence orders, demand for anti-drone systems after recent conflicts, export wins, and the government's push to source defence gear from Indian companies.

quiz.prompt: What is Zen Technologies best known for?
options: Combat training simulators and anti-drone systems

quiz.prompt: Why can Zen's revenue swing a lot?
Which company is a domestic defence rival?

companies.note_30w: Zen Technologies builds combat simulators and anti-drone systems for India's armed forces. Revenue follows lumpy defence orders; watch new contracts and exports.

companies.name: Zensar Technologies

parts.SELLS: Zensar is an IT services company in the RPG Group that builds and runs software, cloud, data and AI systems for clients in banking, insurance, retail, manufacturing and hi-tech.
parts.EARNS: It earns from multi-year technology contracts priced on time spent or fixed outcomes. The US is its largest market, with Europe, led by the UK, and South Africa next. Hi-tech and banking clients are its largest industry groups.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian IT services firm, smaller than leaders like TCS and Infosys. It works with a mix of large global clients across the US, Europe and Africa, and is known for its hi-tech and banking work.
parts.RIVALS: Birlasoft, Mphasis, Coforge, Persistent Systems and Hexaware. Larger firms like Infosys and Wipro also compete for the same clients. Smaller niche firms also compete.
parts.WATCH: Watch how it wins deals in AI-led services, client spending in the US and Europe, and its attempt to grow faster under CEO Manish Tandon. Also watch how it uses AI tools to improve its own delivery.

quiz.prompt: Which business group owns Zensar?
What is Zensar's largest market?
Which company is a mid-sized IT rival?

companies.note_30w: Zensar is a mid-sized RPG Group IT services firm earning mostly from US clients in hi-tech and banking. Watch its AI services push and client spending.

companies.name: Zydus Wellness

parts.SELLS: Zydus Wellness sells health and wellness brands: Complan, Glucon-D, Sugar Free, Nutralite, Everyuth and Nycil. In 2025 it bought Comfort Click, a UK online seller of vitamins and supplements, giving it an international business.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling its brands through grocers, chemists and online. Glucon-D and Nycil peak in summer, so results are seasonal. Sugar Free and Glucon-D lead their categories and are among the most profitable.
parts.SIZE: A leading Indian wellness FMCG company; Sugar Free and Glucon-D are market leaders in their segments. Complan and Everyuth are also well-known household names across India.
parts.RIVALS: HUL (Horlicks), Nestle, Mondelez (Bournvita), Dabur and Emami. Online wellness brands and private labels also compete for health-conscious shoppers. Amul also competes.
parts.WATCH: Watch the integration of Comfort Click, how weather affects summer brands, and growth of its nutrition and personal care lines. It also hired a new chief revenue officer in 2026.

quiz.prompt: Which UK business did Zydus Wellness buy in 2025?
Why are Zydus Wellness results seasonal?
options: Its sales depend on festivals only
Glucon-D and Nycil sell most in summer

quiz.prompt: Which brand competes with Complan?

companies.note_30w: Zydus Wellness owns Complan, Glucon-D, Sugar Free and Nycil, and bought UK supplements seller Comfort Click in 2025. Watch summer demand and the integration.

companies.name: eClerx Services

parts.SELLS: eClerx provides data, analytics and operations services: it runs trade processing and reporting for global banks, manages digital content and online stores for retailers, and handles customer operations for telecom and tech firms.
parts.EARNS: It earns from long-term contracts with large, mostly US and European clients. Financial markets work for big banks is its largest business, and a handful of large clients contribute a big part of revenue.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian knowledge-process company, known for deep work with the world's largest banks. Several of the world's largest banks have been its clients for many years.
parts.RIVALS: EXL, WNS, Genpact, Firstsource and Accenture's operations business. Large IT firms such as TCS and Infosys also compete for bank operations work. So does Wipro.
parts.WATCH: Watch how AI changes the data and process work it does, client concentration, and spending by global banks. Also watch whether it widens its client base beyond financial services.

quiz.prompt: What is eClerx's largest business?
options: Financial markets work for global banks
Running call centres for Indian telecoms

quiz.prompt: What kind of services does eClerx provide?
Which company is a rival to eClerx?

companies.note_30w: eClerx runs data, analytics and operations work for global banks, retailers and telecoms, earning mostly from large US and European clients. Watch AI's impact.

companies.name: Flipkart

parts.SELLS: Flipkart runs India's biggest homegrown e-commerce marketplace, selling phones, electronics, fashion, home goods and groceries. The group also owns Myntra for fashion, Cleartrip for travel, Shopsy for low-cost shopping, Flipkart Minutes for quick commerce and Ekart for logistics. Walmart owns most of it.
parts.EARNS: It earns commissions and fees from sellers, advertising from brands, and logistics charges through Ekart. Ads and seller services are its richest income; big sale events like the Big Billion Days drive a large share of yearly orders.
parts.SIZE: One of India's two largest e-commerce platforms and a leader in online sales of smartphones and fashion. It is also one of India's largest e-commerce employers, with Ekart running a nationwide delivery network.
parts.RIVALS: Amazon India, Meesho, Reliance's JioMart and Ajio, Tata's Croma and BigBasket, and Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart in quick commerce. Myntra faces Ajio and Nykaa Fashion.
parts.WATCH: Flipkart has moved its holding company base from Singapore to India ahead of a planned stock market listing, though it has set no timeline. It has also received an RBI licence to lend. Watch Flipkart Minutes' expansion and e-commerce rules on foreign-owned marketplaces.

quiz.prompt: Which company owns most of Flipkart?
What is Flipkart's quick-commerce service called?
Which is Flipkart's biggest e-commerce rival?

companies.note_30w: Flipkart, majority-owned by Walmart, runs India's biggest homegrown marketplace plus Myntra, Cleartrip and Flipkart Minutes. It earns from commissions and ads; watch its planned listing.

companies.name: Rapido

parts.SELLS: Rapido is a ride-hailing app known for bike taxis, which also offers auto-rickshaw and cab rides across many Indian cities. In 2025 it launched Ownly, a food delivery app, in Bengaluru.
parts.EARNS: Instead of taking a commission on each ride, Rapido charges drivers a daily or monthly subscription fee to use the platform. Bike taxis built its scale; autos and cabs now add a growing share of rides.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest ride-hailing apps and the leader in bike taxis. It operates in a large number of Indian cities and towns, and raised fresh funds led by Prosus in 2026.
parts.RIVALS: Uber, Ola, Namma Yatri and inDrive in rides; Zomato and Swiggy in food delivery. Electric cab and auto services also compete in some cities. Local taxi apps too.
parts.WATCH: Rapido has said it plans to begin preparing for a stock market listing. Watch state rules on bike taxis, which some states have restricted, the growth of Ownly, and whether its subscription model keeps working against Uber and Ola.

companies.name: Byju's (Think & Learn)

parts.SELLS: Byju's, run by Think & Learn Pvt Ltd, sold online learning apps for school students and test prep, and built a group of brands including WhiteHat Jr and stakes in Aakash. Since 2024 it has been in insolvency proceedings and much of its business has shrunk or stopped.
parts.EARNS: It earned from selling course subscriptions to parents, often through an aggressive sales force and financing plans. As demand fell after the pandemic and lenders and creditors went to court, revenue collapsed and its control passed to an insolvency process.
parts.SIZE: Once India's most valuable edtech startup, it is now a shadow of its peak size. At its peak it had a huge student base and ran ads with top cricketers and film stars.
parts.RIVALS: PhysicsWallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, Allen and Aakash. Most of its old market has moved to these rivals and to free content on YouTube. Online test-prep apps also took share.
parts.WATCH: Watch the insolvency case, the court fights between founder Byju Raveendran, US lenders and creditors, and what happens to its remaining brands and stakes.

companies.note_30w: Byju's, once India's most valuable edtech startup, sold learning subscriptions to parents but has been in insolvency since 2024. Watch the court fights over its future.

companies.name: Vedantu

parts.SELLS: Vedantu sells live online classes for school students and coaching for JEE and NEET, along with offline learning centres. It owns Deeksha, a chain of pre-university colleges and coaching centres in Karnataka, which it bought in 2022.
parts.EARNS: It earns from course fees paid by parents for live online courses and from offline programmes, where Deeksha brings steady revenue. It cut costs heavily after the pandemic boom to move towards break-even.
parts.SIZE: One of India's better-known online tutoring brands, though smaller than leaders like PhysicsWallah. Its Deeksha centres give it a strong base in Karnataka.
parts.RIVALS: PhysicsWallah, Unacademy, Allen, Aakash and Byju's. Free content on YouTube also competes for the same students. Offline coaching chains also compete.
parts.WATCH: Watch its shift towards hybrid and offline learning, its push to break even, and new central rules on coaching centres. Also watch whether it raises fresh funding.

companies.note_30w: Vedantu sells live online classes and JEE, NEET coaching, plus offline centres through Deeksha. Watch its move to hybrid learning and push to break even.

companies.name: Eruditus (Emeritus)

parts.SELLS: Eruditus, which sells under the Emeritus brand, offers online and blended executive-education courses, certificates and degrees with universities such as MIT, Wharton, Columbia, Cambridge and the IIMs. Its learners are working professionals around the world.
parts.EARNS: It earns course fees and shares them with partner universities, which lend their names and faculty. Much of its revenue comes from outside India, especially the US and other international markets.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest executive-education platforms and among India's most valuable edtech startups. Its partner list includes many of the world's best-known universities.
parts.RIVALS: upGrad, Coursera, Simplilearn, Great Learning and 2U. Universities' own online programmes also compete for working professionals. Business schools' own executive programmes also compete.

companies.name: Simplilearn

parts.SELLS: Simplilearn sells online bootcamps and certification courses in data science, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, project management and digital marketing, many with partners like Purdue University and Caltech's continuing education centre. It is owned by Blackstone.
parts.EARNS: It earns from course fees paid by individuals and from corporate training deals with companies upskilling their staff. A large part of revenue comes from the US and other overseas learners.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading online upskilling platforms, with learners across many countries. Its courses reach learners and companies in many countries, with the US a major market.
parts.RIVALS: upGrad, Great Learning, Coursera, Emeritus and Udemy. Free courses on YouTube and company training programmes also compete for learners. Pluralsight also competes.

companies.name: LEAD Group (LEAD School)

parts.SELLS: LEAD sells an integrated school system to affordable private schools in smaller towns: curriculum, teacher training, smart-class technology and assessment tools. It also offers English and coding programmes through partner schools.
parts.EARNS: It earns a per-student fee paid by partner schools, which pass it on to parents through school fees. Its core business is the school system for low and mid-fee schools in tier-two and smaller towns.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest school-edtech companies by number of partner schools. It works with a large network of schools across many states, mostly outside big metros.
parts.RIVALS: Extramarks, Next Education, Byju's and Teachmint. Low-cost tablets and free government digital content also compete for schools' budgets. Ed-tech apps sold to parents also compete.

companies.name: Classplus

parts.SIZE: One of India's leading platforms for tutors and creators to build their own learning apps. Its apps are used by a large number of tutors in small towns.

companies.name: Adda247

parts.SELLS: Adda247 sells preparation for government job exams such as banking, SSC, railways, teaching and state public service exams, through its app, YouTube channels, test series, books and some offline centres. Much of its content is in Hindi and regional languages.
parts.EARNS: It earns from course and test-series subscriptions, books and a subscription pass that bundles content. Banking and SSC exams are its core categories, and YouTube is its main funnel for paying users.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest government-exam preparation platforms, especially in Hindi and regional languages. Its YouTube channels have a very large following among job aspirants.
parts.RIVALS: Testbook, PhysicsWallah, Unacademy and Oliveboard. Free YouTube educators also compete for the same aspirants. Offline coaching centres also compete in many towns.

companies.name: Scaler (InterviewBit)

companies.name: Leap Scholar

companies.name: Allen Career Institute

companies.name: Udaan

parts.SIZE: One of India's largest B2B e-commerce platforms for small retailers. It serves a large number of small retailers across many Indian towns and cities. It is among the best-funded B2B startups.
